## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `aws-marketplace-mpm-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Create an IAM user for metering API access

1. <!-- manual: Sign in to the [AWS Management Console](https://console.aws.amazon.com/). -->
2. Navigate to **IAM** > **Users** and select **Create user**.
3. Enter a user name (for example, `marketplace-metering-user`).
4. <!-- manual: Enter a user name (for example, marketplace-metering-user). -->
5. Select **Attach policies directly** and attach the following managed policy:
6. <!-- manual: AWSMarketplaceMeteringFullAccess -->
7. <!-- manual: Complete the user creation wizard. -->

## Step 3: Generate access keys

1. <!-- manual: In the IAM console, select the user you created. -->
2. <!-- manual: Go to the Security credentials tab. -->
3. Under **Access keys**, select **Create access key**.
4. Select **Application running outside AWS** as the use case.
5. <!-- manual: Copy the Access key ID and Secret access key. -->
